title: SAB KHOON KE PYAASE THE MOULA NE JIDHAR DEKHA
body:
Shabbir ne maida'n ka Naqsha hi digar Dekha
<<MINI>>
Sab khoon ke pyaase the Moula ne jidhar Dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas ki dariya par Nazre'n na theherti thi'n
Jab Bharliya Mashkiza mudhkar na udhar Dekha
<<MINI>>
Sab khoon ke pyaase the Moula ne jidhar Dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil thaam liya Apna aur ashk nikal aaye
Sajjad ne Baba ka naize pa jo Sar Dekha
<<MINI>>
Sab khoon ke pyaase the Moula ne jidhar Dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar peet liya Apna ek hashr kiya barpa
Zinda'n me Sakina ne Baba ka jo Sar Dekha
<<MINI>>
Sab khoon ke pyaase the Moula ne jidhar Dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
Maida'n se Ali Akbar waapas huwe khaime me
Maa ne jo Dua kithi Uska ye asar Dekha
<<MINI>>
Sab khoon ke pyaase the Moula ne jidhar Dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
Hulqoom pa zalim ka jab teere sitam aya
Beshir Ne Baba ko bas ek nazar Dekha
<<MINI>>
Sab khoon ke pyaase the Moula ne jidhar Dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
Nazro'n me Mujahid thi tasweer wo furgat ki
Shabbir ne Sughra ko jab waqt-e safar Dekha
<<MINI>>
Sab khoon ke pyaase the Moula ne jidhar Dekha
author: Mujahid Hussain
